newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U tumbles on rumours of U.S. downgrades.
newsitem.headline: P&U tumbles on rumours of U.S. downgrades.

text.p: Swedish/U.S. drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn shares tumbled in Thursday morning trade amid market rumours of U.S. analysts downgrading their earnings for the drugs group.
At 0910 GMT P&U shares were 16 crowns lower at 257 crowns.
"There are rumours that some people in the U.S. have downgraded P&U and some talk of a weaker second quarter," said one analyst who did not wish to be named.
Another broker said rumours of downgrades by investment banks were driving the stock down.

P&U, which was formed in November 1995 through the merger of U.S.'s Upjohn and Sweden's Pharmacia, has itself issued three profit warnings in the past 12 months as it struggles to get the merger to work.
